intent: Show persistent daemon logs in the web settings page with bounded history, live updates and reconnect refresh; include individual file import errors without proactive notifications.

findings.summary: A failed log write escapes the scheduler's error handler and can terminate the daemon. In an isolated home, replacing logs with a file and running scheduler.runImport() after an injected import error throws EEXIST instead of returning.
findings.resolution: MemoryService.log now catches sink failures, reports them to stderr and log event data, and preserves import/scheduler results. Real blocked-path API and startDaemon regressions pass.

findings.summary: 2 instances: readLog returns a nonterminated final line despite promising complete lines, and discards the first complete line when the 256 KiB boundary falls exactly at its start. Isolated fixtures return [complete, partial] and [B] instead of [complete] and [the long complete line, B].
findings.resolution: The bounded reader includes one preceding boundary byte, preserves aligned complete lines, and excludes an unterminated trailing fragment. Exact 64-line byte-boundary and trailing-fragment regressions pass.
